title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier with Towel Bar, Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that combines three tiers of display space and an integrated towel bar. Built for traditional bathroom hardware style, it features solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass to keep essentials organized while saving floor space.

Highlights:
- Triple-tier glass shelving adds storage for toiletries, decor, and daily items
- Integrated towel bar keeps hand towels within reach
- Tempered glass (3/8-inch thick) with beveled edges for strength and safety
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, classic look
- Complements classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Material: Brass hardware
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
